name: Soubise (French Onion Sauce)

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat until foaming. Add onions along with a large pinch of salt and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and most liquid has evaporated, about 20 minutes. Stir in cream and simmer for 5 minutes.

Transfer hot onions and cream to a blender. Add curry powder or Vadouvan if using, and blend, starting at low speed and gradually increasing to high, until a smooth sauce forms. If desired, pass sauce through a fine-mesh strainer, pressing on solids with a spoon, for an even more refined texture. Return onion sauce to saucepan and season with salt and white pepper (note that sauce should have a texture that's thicker than most sauces but thinner than a puree). Keep warm.

description: Made from only three ingredients—butter, onions, and cream—this classic French onion sauce is elegant, luxurious, and incredibly simple to make. Our recipe also gives the option to add French Vadouvan curry powder.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 teaspoon curry powder or Vadouvan spice, optional (see note)

Notes: Vadouvan, a French curry powder flavored with shallots and garlic, is available in specialty food stores and online.
author: Daniel Gritzer
